1. Case overview

Summary. 8 plans: 7 NeoArc (DMAT) variants and 1 reference plan.

Clinical background and rationale. Chest wall + nodes ± IMN. 42.56 Gy in 16 fractions

Plan generation. NeoArc (DMAT) plan generated for: Accela. NeoArc (DMAT): 8FFF, 2 arcs; modulation -3, -2, -1, 0, +1, +2, +3. Reference setup: CW+LN TB VMAT: 6FFF, 4 arcs.

Goal setup. 43 provided goals per NeoArc (DMAT) plan. Goal thresholds and priorities are listed in the planning tables; derived and supporting objectives are separate. Example from DA227: Body D0.03 cm3 ≤ 44.68 Gy (P1.1).

Comparison methods. Compared the dose colorwash, DVHs, quality–time graph and individual endpoint–time graphs. Dose normalization factors: 1. NeoArc (DMAT): Technical report estimate; CW+LN TB VMAT: RT Plan control-point estimate. Durations do not represent total room time.

2. Dose colorwash

Compare target coverage and dose spread at the same slice.

Dose viewer loads when visible.

Scroll over a dose image to change slices. Use the slider or arrow keys as an alternative. Dragging is disabled.

5 GyRx 42.6 Gy48.5 Gy

Colorwash sampling details

Every dose is evaluated on DA227’s patient-coordinate dose grid before CT slices are sampled every 5 mm from its isocenter. Native grids that differ are trilinearly resampled. The in-plane display and superior–inferior slice range are restricted to the selected reference plan’s 40% prescription-dose bounding volume plus 50 mm in every direction; CT slices outside that range are not embedded. Each colorwash has a slim slice slider beneath it; moving any slider advances every plan synchronously. Scroll over an image or use arrow keys to change slices. Dragging is disabled. Centered zoom (+/−) and reset (0 or double-click) remain synchronized. All plans use the confirmed 5–48.5 Gy color scale.

Scoring method

Imported or selected score curves, weights, and thresholds are retained. The traffic-light summary classifies evaluated values as goal, variation, or deviation; missing or unmapped endpoints contribute zero points. Native technical-report compliance scores remain separate.
